title: Pokerama
description:
A common first-semester assignment was to make a card game like blackjack, so I developed a system for rendering playing cards and used it in several projects, including this poker game.

This one includes some lines and colors to make the space feel more 3D.

![](assets/projects/college/pokerama/screenshot-1.webp)In 2022, I built a small Windows [command prompt emulator](https://github.com/tjvezina/cmd-emulator) in **p5.js** so I could recreate this and other projects in a web context, and keep them alive and playable for longer.
